test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the peculiar character of allochromatic minerals?

options.text: These minerals are colored due to impurities.
These minerals are naturally-coloured minerals without any impurities.
These minerals are colourless and very explosive.

solution:
The correct answer is __**These minerals are coloured due to impurities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Minerals that are **colourless in their pure form** are known as **Allochromatic Minerals**.
 
• These minerals **show colours due to the presence of small quantities of “Colouring” agents**.
